name: Authentik
description: Protect any site (reverse proxy, served files, ...) with Authentik forward authentication (auth_request).

USE_AUTHENTIK.help: Activate Authentik forward authentication for this site.
USE_AUTHENTIK.label: Use Authentik

AUTHENTIK_URL.help: Base URL of the Authentik outpost; required when USE_AUTHENTIK is enabled.
AUTHENTIK_URL.label: Authentik outpost URL

AUTHENTIK_OUTPOST_PATH.help: Local path exposing Authentik outpost endpoints; must start with /.
AUTHENTIK_OUTPOST_PATH.label: Outpost local path

AUTHENTIK_SSL_VERIFY.help: Verify the Authentik outpost TLS certificate for auth checks and SSO proxying.
AUTHENTIK_SSL_VERIFY.label: Verify Authentik TLS certificate

AUTHENTIK_TIMEOUT.help: Timeout (ms) for the Lua auth subrequest to the Authentik outpost.
AUTHENTIK_TIMEOUT.label: Auth subrequest timeout (ms)

AUTHENTIK_PROXY_BUFFER_SIZE.help: NGINX proxy_buffer_size value for large Authentik response headers.
AUTHENTIK_PROXY_BUFFER_SIZE.label: proxy_buffer_size

AUTHENTIK_PROXY_BUFFERS.help: NGINX proxy_buffers value for large Authentik response headers.
AUTHENTIK_PROXY_BUFFERS.label: proxy_buffers

AUTHENTIK_PASS_IDENTITY_HEADERS.help: Forward Authentik identity headers to upstreams that use trusted-header authentication.
AUTHENTIK_PASS_IDENTITY_HEADERS.label: Forward identity headers to upstream

AUTHENTIK_IDENTITY_HEADERS.default: X-authentik-username X-authentik-groups X-authentik-entitlements X-authentik-email X-authentik-name X-authentik-uid
AUTHENTIK_IDENTITY_HEADERS.help: Space- or comma-separated identity headers to forward when AUTHENTIK_PASS_IDENTITY_HEADERS is enabled.
AUTHENTIK_IDENTITY_HEADERS.label: Identity headers to forward
